## Project title

Personal Portfolio Brand and Content Strategy

## Data and source

The project uses my résumé, coursework, portfolio content, and the requirements for this Quarto website.

## Managerial problem

My marketing, creative work, and graduate analytics coursework are spread across different roles and assignments. I need one place to organize them for job applications.

## Target audience

Recruiters, hiring managers, and professional contacts looking for an early-career digital marketing or marketing analytics candidate.

## Research questions and objectives

- Which experiences best communicate my current strengths?
- How should projects be organized so visitors can find relevant work quickly?
- How can the website maintain a consistent tone and visual identity?

## Expected impact

The portfolio should make my background easier to understand and give visitors one place to review my résumé and projects.

## Planned methods

Content review, audience definition, deciding how to present my background, basic SEO, and testing the website on different screen sizes.
